basic_info.description: Prime Cole Valley! Located in the rear of a well-managed 6-unit 1912 Edwardian, this updated one-bedroom + bonus room, one-bath condo enjoys south-facing views of Sutro Tower and Mt. Olympus. Renovated in 2019, with the bathroom refreshed more recently, the home blends original character with modern updates. Leaded windows, built-ins, and a tiled wood-burning fireplace pair with newer flooring, fresh paint, a refreshed kitchen, and updated lighting. The spacious bedroom is complemented by a versatile bonus room, ideal for a home office, nursery or guest space. Sunlight from 3 exposures fills the home, while ample storage, including a generous walk-in closet, adds functionality. The bathroom features a new soaking tub w/tile surround, new vanity, and new lighting. Residents share a serene garden, in-building laundry (with potential for in-unit laundry) and dedicated storage. In the heart of Cole Valley, this home is surrounded by tree-lined streets, historic architecture, and a village-like atmosphere w/Zazie, InoVino, Wooden Brewery, Blue Barn, Cole Hardware & Luke's Local Market & more right around the corner. Golden Gate Park and Whole Foods are close by & Muni access in front of building makes car-free living effortless. Low HOA dues of $500 include in-unit heat, gas & water!
